limitations.note: The agent fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also removed the original one-clock lag in the Gray pointers, changing when `wfull` and `rempty` update; it additionally gated RAM accesses during reset and changed how RAM depth is chosen.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide when transfers occurred, so it checked FIFO ordering without independently verifying the cycle-by-cycle flag timing that the rewrite changed.
